fields.description: Issue includes editorials and columns criticizing a proposed Florida sales tax and urging readers to submit ballots opposing it; an article calling for Miami Beach City Manager Claude Renshaw to confront alleged gambling syndicate influence or resign; and a piece alleging misconduct by Dr. Earl Moore. Additional local reporting covers Miami Beach property assessment disputes, city court cases involving drunkenness and drunk driving, sidewalk and infrastructure concerns, and a report on the limited remaining oceanfront sites for new hotels on Miami Beach. Includes a Florida Medical Association health topic on birthmarks and various advertisements and coupons.
